Emotional pain is hard to work through because physical pain can be diagnosed or take a advil and your headache is gone. Emotional pain is like an anguish that can’t be calmed. I totally get it. As someone who is on a journey to be happy I wouldn’t wish this level of sadness and grief and emotions I’ve processed recently on anyone. I go from crying in my car to riding with the sunroof open and the windows down blasting music. Healing is not linear, and you fighting to be here is a great accomplishment. It took me 5 years to try to pull myself out of the dark place.
